maker: Shenzhen Legend Robot Technology Co., Ltd.
name: Legend Robot LQ04B Tile Laying Robot
summary: Mobile floor-tiling robot that applies adhesive and lays 600 × 600 or 800 × 800 mm floor tiles in batches of five, aligning each tile by camera. Workers refill material and do edges, corners and cuts.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller found; enquiries go to the maker in Shenzhen. Legend Robot exhibited at BATIMAT 2026 in Paris and names a European partner (ROBOSWISS AG) for its spraying robots, but nothing for the tile robot.

specs.label: Tiles per cycle
specs.conditions: 5 tiles per 10-minute cycle, 120 s per tile

specs.label: Output per day
specs.quote: the robot can lay 80–120 standard tiles per day

specs.label: Tiling precision
specs.conditions: spec table; marketing text elsewhere claims ±0.1 mm joint error

specs.label: Footprint
specs.value: under 1,000 mm wide and 800 mm deep
specs.quote: Designed with a footprint of less than 1000 mm in width and 800 mm in depth

specs.label: Battery
specs.value: 48 V, 105 Ah; 4 h + 4 h with 2 batteries

specs.label: Crew
specs.quote: One automatic tile laying robot works with two workers: one for operation, one for material refilling

notes: Same-direction pick-and-place arm (no rotation) so it can work in narrow rooms, corridors and lifts; deep-learning vision measures tile-to-tile position.
Controls adhesive distribution to avoid hollow tiles (maker).
Robot lays full tiles; workers do edges, corners and finishing.
Drive type is not stated (mobile chassis, ±30 mm navigation accuracy, 10° climbing angle, 30 mm obstacles); wheels assumed.
